correctness.rationale: Exact full vertex description, four quadratic squared-distance classes, strict screening inequalities and explicit convex-hull-of-contact support prove the stated unique optimal enclosing ball for every p,q>=1. The integer phase threshold follows from an irrational quadratic root; the exceptional origin case is checked. The provided exact verifier (standard-library fractions and independent H-to-V facet enumeration) passed 40,131 assertions on 6,400 integer parameter pairs and 1,639 individual vertex distances. The proof is analytical and universal; finite checks serve as corroboration.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite two-part composition-polytope subfamily obtains a canonical standard Euclidean minimum-ball classification: exact rational center, radius and all contacts, with an arithmetic phase threshold and wholesale block-contact collapse. This metric equality structure is absent from the known combinatorial product-of-simplices and Ehrhart descriptions, and furnishes a motivated base case for higher-part compositions.
